g.text: Data flow: a step sends its own request
keyed by driver name, so it
the run stops before any scenario
the options scoped to the base_url host
[detached: FileDownloadTrait, the MetatagTrait hreflang return-link check]
a fresh HttpBrowser: cookies for their own host,
headers and credentials for the base_url host only
a fresh HttpBrowser with an empty cookie jar
sent with the session options only
when the host is the base_url host
page client: the response is the new page.
detached or bare: it stays in the trait's own
state or the step, and the page is untouched.
